title: When anger starts keeping score
subtitle: For the hurt that wants to rank everyone else
description: Begin with Truth that stands before every injury. These readings help anger stop building a courtroom out of comparison.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The Mool Mantar places the heart before timeless Truth, not before the scoreboard anger wants to keep.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Before anger ranks another person, return to the One Truth that does not need your grievance to become real.

evidence.coreClaim: This path catches the moment heat becomes comparison and returns the heart to Truth before it starts grading other lives.
evidence.turn: Anger loses authority when timeless Truth is allowed to outrank the private scoreboard.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name the injury plainly, then refuse the second wound of measuring your life against theirs.
